findings.title: IKEv1 Detected
findings.description: IKEv1 is considered legacy and has known vulnerabilities including susceptibility to aggressive-mode dictionary attacks and weaker PFS guarantees.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to IKEv2, which provides stronger security guarantees and mandatory EAP support.

findings.title: Weak or Deprecated Encryption Algorithm
findings.description: The observed encryption algorithm '3DES-CBC' is considered weak or deprecated and does not meet modern cryptographic standards.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to AES-GCM-256 or AES-GCM-128 (AEAD ciphers preferred).

findings.title: Weak Diffie-Hellman Group
findings.description: The DH group 'Alternate 1024-bit MODP group' provides an insufficient security margin against modern attacks (e.g., Logjam). Groups 1, 2, and 5 are deprecated.
findings.recommendation: Use DH Group 14 (2048-bit MODP) as minimum, or ECP groups 19/20/21.
findings.evidence: Observed in IKE Key Exchange payload: Alternate 1024-bit MODP group

findings.title: Certificate/Signature-Based Authentication
findings.description: The observed authentication method 'RSA Signatures' uses asymmetric cryptography.
findings.recommendation: Ensure certificate chain validity and key lengths meet your policy.
